findings.where: PLAN.md §0-i vs ep01.md 人数 table (s02/s19)
findings.what: PLAN 0-i states the feet-POV is population 0 + body_parts {foot:2}; ep01 sets population 1 + {foot:2}.
findings.why: sVL policy (CLAUDE.md) counts bodies and L52 checks arithmetic against population (2 feet = 1 body), so 0+foot2 is arithmetically invalid and contradicts PLAN's own '人数は体を数える'. ep01's 1+foot2 is the checker-compliant, faithful formalization of the source's '自分の足元'.
findings.fix: Correct PLAN.md 0-i to 1 + {foot:2} to match ep01 and the sVL policy; keep ep01 as is.

findings.what: '指・まぶた・息だけが動く。体は動かない' contradicts the eight-organ pass (s12a 手・s13 喉・s14a 腕・s15b 背 all move).
findings.why: Inherited from PLAN 0-g's style-card Motion character, but read at episode level it forbids the very organ movements that are the episode's content; a generator handed this could freeze the scooping hand.
findings.fix: Clarify that the limited-animation style governs idle motion and the eight organs are the deliberate moving exception (one organ per shot).

findings.where: ep01.md 運動（作品定数）vs 仮ショット割り 運動 column
findings.what: '寄りと引きだけ' is contradicted by the column's 送り (track), チルト (s04), 前進 (s06), 見下ろし (s02), and by '止めと送り' itself.
findings.why: The camera-move vocabulary actually used exceeds 'only push-in/pull-back' — an internal contradiction inside the same section.
findings.fix: Replace '寄りと引きだけ' with the actual allowed moves (寄り・引き・送り・チルト・前進・見下ろし) or drop it and keep only 'カメラは低く、ほぼ動かない'.

findings.where: ep01.md 仮ショット割り s13 vs ショット表_第1話.md S13/検証2
findings.what: The shot-level '喉の横から。顔は画面に入れない' and the asymmetry '視聴者は見る。送り火は見ない' are softened to the general '送り火の正面アップは取らない'.
findings.why: Face-out-of-frame for S13 and the viewer-sees/送り火-doesn't asymmetry are the episode's core (検証3: 'この非対称が第1話の全部'); a 'no frontal closeup' rule still permits a profile that includes the face.
findings.fix: Carry '喉の横から、顔を画面に入れない' and '視聴者は見る・送り火は見ない' explicitly into s13.

findings.where: ep01.md 切る規則 / 仮ショット割り s12b, s12c
findings.what: 指 spans two shots (s12b 頁をめくる, s12c 火を押す), so '八つを一度ずつ' is loosely 9 organ-shots for 8 organs.
findings.why: Faithful to the draft (指 does two distinct actions, correctly cut by one-change), but the 'once each' wording is slightly off.
findings.fix: Optionally note 指 spans two shots; no content change required.

note: This is a clean, source-traceable v01 cut: every one of the 27 shots maps to a ショット表 row, the 300-second beat timing sums exactly, the throat's burn is kept distinct from the guest's fire, 花's absence is resolved against 台帳/README, and s02/s19 population 1+foot2 is the checker-correct formalization (PLAN's 0+foot2 is the error). No must criterion falls below 31, so no cap. The remaining issues are internal-consistency in the 運動 section and a few shot-level instructions (s13 face-out-of-frame) softened from the source.
